args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (1): r07, check_failed_but_accepted. Its closure value is 2.776 against a 1.0 threshold but is recorded as passed. Its profile also has another shape: the largest flank difference is at 347 µm, against 84 µm in every other run (z 6.38). It is the only run made with no remedy kept and a single step.
Cleared (7): r01, r02, r03, r04, r05, r06, r08. All three checks pass well within threshold, and peak position, growth-zone length and flank-difference position all match the batch. r01's REGR peak has a z of 2.88 only because the batch MAD is 0. The actual gap is 53.24 vs 53.1 %/h, about 0.3 %.
What the flagged run shows: the closure mismatch means the tip motion from the midline and stage log does not agree with the tip motion from the tracked kinematics. The shifted flank difference points to a different curvature-rate profile. The closure check's pass flag should be looked at, because it recorded a value over threshold as passed.
